thread:
sam: Heads up — since the RBAC refactor this morning I'm seeing ~120 failed deploys to the GPU pool in the last hour, all with KMS decrypt errors. CI falls back to legacy SA and then hits audit 'impersonation' entries. Anyone triaging? :eyes:

tara: Seen it. Repro'd in staging: deploy-job tries to fetch `secret/modelkey` and KMS returns 403. Audit shows `kms.decrypt` denied.

linh: That sounds like the new least-priv role we rolled out removed the KMS permission but we never scoped the old binding. Previously a cluster-wide role allowed decrypt; refactor tightened it but didn't grant the specific key resource.

sam: Can you paste the actual audit lines so we can confirm the principal and resource? Also which SA is hitting the key?

tara: Paste from audit: `time=2026-03-19T14:02:10Z principal=system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-runner-sa action=kms.decrypt resource=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rdw-keys/cryptoKeys/rdw-prod-embed result=DENY reason=policy_mismatch`

security-bot: Automated note: recent RBAC patch removed wildcard resource on kms:decrypt for `deploy-runner-role`. Recommended fix: add a narrowly-scoped Role allowing `kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt` for the specific key resource and bind to `ci:deploy-runner-sa`. :lock:

linh: Quick mitigation I tested: create a Role in `ci` namespace with the minimal permission, then RoleBinding to `deploy-runner-sa`. That unblocks deploys without reintroducing cluster-wide KMS access.

tara: YAML snippet I will PR (short):
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: ci-kms-decrypt-role
  namespace: ci
rules:
- apiGroups: ["cloud.google.com"] # placeholder for external KMS CRD mapping
  resources: ["keys"]
  verbs: ["decrypt"]
```
RoleBinding:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: ci-kms-decrypt-binding
  namespace: ci
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-runner-sa
  namespace: ci
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: ci-kms-decrypt-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

sam: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) add an audit alert that pages on `kms.decrypt` DENY for any deploy SA, 2) add a gate to the RBAC refactor checklist to run the tiny simulation script that calls the key with the SA before merge.

linh: Agreed. I can add the simulation script to the infra repo: `scripts/check-sa-perms.sh --sa ci:deploy-runner-sa --permission kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt --resource rdw-prod-embed`. It will call the testing API and fail the check.

tara: I'll open the PR with the Role/RoleBinding and the alert rule. Will tag @sam and @linh for quick review. Plan: apply to staging, validate one successful GPU deploy, then apply to prod during low traffic window.

sam: Thanks. Also note: there were a couple of suspicious audit lines showing `impersonation` events from a different namespace — we'll follow up to ensure no leaked RBAC in CI templates. I'll create a short postmortem note after we stabilize. :+1:

security-bot: Reminder: after patch, run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy rdw-prod-embed --location global --keyring rdw-keys` to confirm bindings and keep principle of least privilege.

tara: ACK, PR in ~10m.
